+_COPY_CHUNK_SIZE = 1024 * 1024

+
+class ArchiveTooLargeError(ValueError):
+    """Raised when an archive would extract to more than the allowed number of bytes."""

+def _safe_member_path(dest: Path, name: str) -> Path:
+    # mirror zipfile's sanitisation (drop drive/root/".." parts), then verify containment
+    parts = [p for p in name.replace("\\", "/").split("/") if p not in ("", ".", "..") and not p.endswith(":")]
+    target = dest.joinpath(*parts) if parts else dest
+    if not target.resolve().is_relative_to(dest.resolve()):
+        raise ValueError(f"Unsafe path in archive: {name}")
+    return target
+

+def extract_zip(archive: str | Path | IO[bytes], dest: str | Path, max_size: int | None = None) -> int:
+    """Extract a zip archive into `dest`, refusing archives whose uncompressed size exceeds `max_size`.
+
+    `max_size` defaults to the module-level MAX_EXTRACTED_ARCHIVE_SIZE, read at call time.
+    Declared sizes are checked before anything is written; actual bytes written are also bounded
+    in case headers understate the size. Returns the total number of bytes extracted.
+    """
+    limit = MAX_EXTRACTED_ARCHIVE_SIZE if max_size is None else max_size
+    dest_path = Path(dest)
+
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zf:
+        members = zf.infolist()
+        declared = sum(m.file_size for m in members)
+        if declared > limit:
+            raise ArchiveTooLargeError(f"Archive expands to {declared} bytes, exceeding the limit of {limit} bytes")
+
+        dest_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        written = 0
+        for member in members:
+            target = _safe_member_path(dest_path, member.filename)
+            if member.is_dir():
+                target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+                continue
+
+            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

+                while chunk := src.read(_COPY_CHUNK_SIZE):
+                    written += len(chunk)
+                    if written > limit:
+                        raise ArchiveTooLargeError(f"Archive expands beyond the limit of {limit} bytes")
+                    out.write(chunk)
+
+    return written
